6 May 2026

Monetary Policy Report

Monetary Policy Report, 6 May 2026.

Summary

CPI inflation is projected to average 2.0 per cent in 2026 and 1.8 per cent in 2027.

Demand and output

Real GDP is expected to grow by 1.0 per cent in 2026 and 1.3 per cent in 2027.

Domestic demand continued to expand at a moderate pace.

Supply, costs and prices

Inflation has declined markedly from the peak.

The labour market

Unemployment is expected to average 4.2 per cent in 2026. Wage growth is projected to be 4.5 per cent in 2026.

Financial conditions

Financial conditions have eased somewhat in recent months.

Monetary policy

The MPC decided to maintain Bank Rate.

Monetary policy will be restrictive for as long as necessary.

Risks

Risks to the growth outlook are tilted to the downside. The risks surrounding the inflation outlook were broadly balanced.

Annex

This annex describes the forecast methodology.

Bank of England, 2026
